summary: daemon_load reads its CPU budget from slo/targets.toml and reports each path's descriptive SLO target without gating on it

replay.detail: Test and CI reporting only; no daemon change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Load reports gain two optional fields; older baselines without them still load. Budgets, WORSE and slack are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting drops the reported target columns; the CPU budget stays 2 cores.
